title: auditlog: dual-write legacy + schema-v1 event names (env cutover flag)
author: Benji Okafor
description: Context: we’re rolling out the canonical audit event schema v1, but several customers (and internal tooling) still depend on legacy event names. This PR introduces a dual-write path for a small, explicit set of sensitive actions so we can (1) keep legacy consumers working and (2) validate schema v1 end-to-end in production before flipping to v1-only. Summary of changes: Adds a shared helper in auditlog emitter to optionally emit *two* events for a single action: one with legacy event_name and one with schema v1 event_name, sharing the same event_id/request_id/actor/target payload. Adds a runtime config flag to control behavior per environment: AUDIT_LOG_EVENT_NAME_MODE=legacy|dual|v1 (default=dual in prod, v1 in staging once we flip). Adds an allowlisted mapping file for selected actions (initial set: API key create/rotate/revoke; RBAC role create/update/delete; RBAC policy bundle publish). Adds metrics to detect skew during dual-write (counts by event_name namespace, and a ratio panel-friendly metric). Adds safeguards: dual-write is only enabled for registered v1 event names; if the v1 name is missing from registry, we fail closed (don’t emit legacy-only) to avoid silently losing coverage. Legacy payload compatibility: we do not attempt to reshape the legacy payload beyond attaching request_id/actor when available; legacy event schema remains as-is. The schema v1 event payload is the canonical envelope. Notes for downstream: During dual mode, the pipeline will ingest two records per action. Dedupe is handled at the consumer/query layer via (event_id, event_name). The Console Audit Logs UI will be configured to show v1 events by default once cutover begins; legacy events remain queryable via the raw export sinks if needed. Rollout plan: 1) Enable dual in prod (default) and verify counts/lag dashboards; 2) Switch staging to v1-only for 48h; 3) Flip prod to v1-only after exporter + coverage scanner confirm steady state; 4) Remove legacy emission in a follow-up PR after deprecation window. Testing: Unit tests for mapping + mode selection; integration test harness updated to accept both names when mode=dual; added a regression test ensuring we never emit legacy-only when v1 registry lookup fails. References: ENG-2490 (migration plan), PR #18421 (schema v1), PR #18437 (registry), PR #18452/#18466 (instrumentation).

review_conversation: Allison Grant: Can we avoid double-counting in the delivery metrics dashboards? We’ll see 2x events for some actions in dual mode; needs to be explicit in the metric naming.

Benji Okafor (author): Good call. I added `auditlog_migration_dualwrite_total{mode,event_namespace}` so dashboards can filter to v1-only counts. Also added a short note in docs/internal/audit-logging/migration.md.
Marcus Lin: Please confirm the failure mode when the v1 name isn’t registered. We should not silently emit legacy-only events; that’s a coverage risk.
Benji Okafor (author): Updated `emitWithMode()` to fail closed if mode=dual|v1 and v1 name is missing from registry. Added a unit test `dual_mode_missing_registry_fails()`.
Nadia Rahman: For dual-write, do both events share the same event_id? That’s important for downstream correlation and for SIEM dedupe strategies.
Benji Okafor (author): Yes, both records share `event_id` and `request_id`; only `event_name` differs. I added a comment + test asserting shared IDs.
Amara Diallo: Gateway propagation: are we guaranteed to have actor.request_id/ip/user_agent on both? One code path was missing user_agent earlier.

Benji Okafor (author): Both events come from the same constructed envelope so actor + request context are identical. I also ensured the gateway middleware attaches user_agent when present (no behavior change, just fixes the missing pass-through).
Marcus Lin: Approved once the docs call out recommended prod default and the deprecation window expectation (we’ll be asked by customers).
Benji Okafor (author): Added doc section “Operational defaults” + note that legacy names are expected to remain available for at least one full minor release after v1-only cutover.
Nadia Rahman: LGTM after the metric rename + test updates.
release_notes: Audit logging: added per-environment cutover flag for event naming (legacy/dual/v1) and enabled dual-write for a limited set of sensitive actions to support migration to schema v1.
